Ciudad del Sol Circuit

Regenerating track models:
  From the solution runtime directory, with trackgen, accc, stripe, and the shared
  texture/surface pool installed. The input/output directory is the tracked package:
  trackgen -c experimental -n ciudad-del-sol-circuit -i ../data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit -o ../data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit -a -q
  trackgen -c experimental -n ciudad-del-sol-circuit -i ../data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit -o ../data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit -r -q
  accc -g ../data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/ciudad-del-sol-circuit.acc -l0 ../data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/ciudad-del-sol-circuit.ac -l1 ../data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/ciudad-del-sol-circuit-trk-raceline.ac -d3 1000 -d2 500 -d1 300 -S 300 -es

Refreshing review SVGs and the menu map:
  From the solution root with torcs-tracktools installed:
  torcs-compare-overlay --align-closed --track-xml data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/ciudad-del-sol-circuit.xml --polyline data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/source/centerline.json --overlay data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/source/xml-centerline-fit.svg --report data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/source/xml-centerline-fit-report.json
  torcs-render-track-map --track-xml data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/ciudad-del-sol-circuit.xml --output data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/ciudad-del-sol-circuit.png --svg-output data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/source/track-map.svg
  torcs-render-labeled-segments-svg --track-xml data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/ciudad-del-sol-circuit.xml --output data/tracks/experimental/ciudad-del-sol-circuit/source/segments-labeled.svg

Third-party data:
- The geographic path data of this track is partially derived from OpenStreetMap contributors, relation 16251935 and its member ways,
  accessed 15 August 2026. It has been significantly modified and extended for TORCS. The underlying base data is provided under
  the Open Database License (ODbL): https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
  The separately mapped pit lane is derived from OpenStreetMap ways 638504647 and 772763791. TORCS uses a 300 m, 20-place right-side pit host
  aligned with the mapped main-straight pit location.
- Elevation source: Road elevation, smoothed banking, terrain relief, and the generated terrain heightmap are derived from INEGI Modelo
  Digital de Elevacion Tipo Terreno 1.5 m tile E14A39C3 (UPC 889463846604), edition 2020. The bare-earth terrain model was generated by
  INEGI from photogrammetric relief-altimetry data and uses Mexico ITRF2008 / UTM zone 14N with orthometric heights referenced to
  Geoide Gravimetrico Mexicano 2010. Downloaded 15 August 2026 from: https://www.inegi.org.mx/app/geo2/elevacionesmex/
  INEGI terms of use: https://www.inegi.org.mx/inegi/terminos.html
